properties.name: mybatis-plus.upsert.dynamic.enabled
properties.description: Whether to enable dynamic datasource upsert auto-configuration

properties.name: mybatis-plus.upsert.dynamic.use-new-mysql-syntax
properties.description: Global default for whether to use the new MySQL upsert syntax (AS new). Can be overridden per data source.

properties.name: mybatis-plus.upsert.dynamic.datasource
properties.description: Data source configurations for dynamic upsert. Key is data source name (must match spring.datasource.dynamic.datasource keys). When db-type is not specified, it is automatically inferred from the JDBC URL.

properties.name: mybatis-plus.upsert.dynamic.datasource.*.db-type
properties.description: Database type for this data source. Optional: auto-inferred from JDBC URL if not specified. Values: mysql | postgresql | oracle | sqlserver | h2 | custom

properties.name: mybatis-plus.upsert.dynamic.datasource.*.use-new-mysql-syntax
properties.description: Whether to use the new MySQL upsert syntax (AS new, MySQL 8.0.19+) for this data source. When not specified, inherits the global mybatis-plus.upsert.dynamic.use-new-mysql-syntax setting; only an explicit true/false overrides it. Only applicable for MySQL.

properties.name: mybatis-plus.upsert.dynamic.datasource.*.dialect-ref
properties.description: Bean name of a user-defined UpsertDialect to use when db-type=custom. Required only when db-type is custom; ignored for built-in db types.

properties.name: mybatis-plus.upsert.dynamic.fill-strategy
properties.description: Auto-fill strategy applied before the upsert SQL is bound (fill runs before dialect routing).
